sources.title: VENTURE experiment: exploratory notes on declined feature requests
sources.excerpt: Where a declined feature can be built as an add-on, free add-ons appear quickly.

evidence.claim: Highly upvoted declined feature requests are rare: only 31 feature-like requests with at least 20 upvotes among 668 'not planned' issues across 82 popular developer-tool repositories.
None of the 9 reviewed declined requests was a buildable, unserved add-on opportunity, and no thread contained an offer to pay.
Where a declined feature can be built as an add-on, free community add-ons appear quickly (five Neovim plugins for Gemini CLI, two plugins for herdr).
evidence.quote: Where a declined feature can be built as an add-on, free add-ons appear quickly.
